import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import uproot
from uproot.writing.identify import to_TH1x,to_TAxis
sys.path.insert(0,"autonomous_allhad")
from gnn_lowdm._implementation.plot_lowdm30_sr_categories import CATEGORIES,BENCHMARKS,PROCESS_ORDER
sys.path.insert(0,"autonomous_allhad/workflow")
from plot_highdm73_from_limit_templates import nominal_names
c=Path("autonomous_allhad/workflow/histograms/lepton_veto10_20260908")
p=c/"plots"
out=p/"sr_inputs"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
config=json.loads(Path("autonomous_allhad/gnn_lowdm/config.json").read_text())["sr_binning"]
mapping={"VV":"VV_VVV","Top":"Top","DY":"DY","Photon":"PhotonJet","W":"WtoLNu","Zinv":"Zto2Nu","QCD":"QCD"}
audit={"years":{},"input_kind":"current canonical datacard templates only","sr_observations_read":False}
for year in ["2024","2025"]:
    d=c/"cards"/year/"T2bW"
    bm=json.loads((d/"bin_map.json").read_text())["lowdm"]
    assert len(bm)==30
    card=d/"cards/datacard_mStop1200_mLSP500.txt"
    if not card.exists(): raise RuntimeError(str(card))
    rates={}
    for line in card.read_text().splitlines():
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)>4 and parts[1]=="rateParam":
            rates[(parts[2],parts[3])]=float(parts[4])
    yp={"source":str(d/"templates.root"),"card":str(card),"categories":{}}
    with uproot.open(d/"templates.root") as source, uproot.recreate(out/(year+".root")) as target:
        for cat in CATEGORIES:
            rows=[r for r in bm if "SR_"+r["category"]==cat]
            edges=np.array(config["edges_by_category"][cat[3:]],dtype=float)
            assert len(rows)==5
            np.testing.assert_array_equal([r["score_bin"] for r in rows],range(5))
            np.testing.assert_array_equal([rows[0]["score_edges"][0]]+[r["score_edges"][1] for r in rows],edges)
            payload={}
            for process in [*PROCESS_ORDER,*[b[0] for b in BENCHMARKS]]:
                vals=[];vars=[]
                for row in rows:
                    ch=row["channel"];directory=source[ch]
                    if process.startswith("signal_"):
                        names=[process.replace("signal_","sig_",1)]
                    else:
                        prefix=mapping[process]
                        names=[n for n in nominal_names(directory) if n==prefix or n.startswith(prefix+"_")]
                    value=variance=0.
                    for name in names:
                        h=directory[name]
                        factor=rates.get((ch,name),1.)
                        value+=float(h.values()[0])*factor
                        variance+=float(h.variances()[0])*factor**2
                    vals.append(value);vars.append(variance)
                vals=np.array(vals);vars=np.array(vars)
                assert np.isfinite(vals).all() and np.isfinite(vars).all() and (vars>=0).all()
                centers=(edges[:-1]+edges[1:])/2
                target[f"{cat}/{process}"]=to_TH1x(None,"",np.r_[0.,vals,0.],float(len(vals)),float(vals.sum()),float(vars.sum()),float((vals*centers).sum()),float((vals*centers**2).sum()),np.r_[0.,vars,0.],to_TAxis("xaxis","",len(vals),float(edges[0]),float(edges[-1]),edges))
                payload[process]={"sumw":vals.tolist(),"sumw2":vars.tolist()}
            yp["categories"][cat]=payload
    with uproot.open(out/(year+".root")) as check:
        for cat,payload in yp["categories"].items():
            for proc,row in payload.items():
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(check[f"{cat}/{proc}"].values(),row["sumw"])
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(check[f"{cat}/{proc}"].variances(),row["sumw2"])
    previous=json.loads((p/year/"sr"/f"lowdm30_sr_{year}.json").read_text())
    old=np.concatenate([b["background"] for b in previous["blocks"]])
    new=np.concatenate([np.sum([v["sumw"] for k,v in cat.items() if k in PROCESS_ORDER],axis=0) for cat in yp["categories"].values()])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(new,old,rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-10)
    yp["background_total"]=float(new.sum())
    yp["unchanged_background_relative_tolerance"]=1e-12
    yp["plot_input_root_sha256"]=hashlib.sha256((out/(year+".root")).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    audit["years"][year]=yp
print(json.dumps({"audit":audit,"binning":{"best_by_scheme":{"nb2_nisr3":{"category_labels":config["category_labels"],"edges_by_category":config["edges_by_category"]}}}}))
PY
